      nisa.tensor_copy(dst=res_sb, src=res_psum)

      # Copy the result from SBUF to HBM.
      nisa.dma_copy(dst=result[m * TILE_M:(m + 1) * TILE_M,
                               n * TILE_N:(n + 1) * TILE_N],
